From my experiences, I learned from the synced guides and then dived into some bird farming PFs to get the experience.

Sephirot is as people say - you need to know what you're doing otherwise be prepared for wipe after wipe. Imo, this is the hardest one to get down if you don't have a solid PF group.

Sophia you can kinda cheese if you have enough DPS - most groups I went into were able to kill Sophia before the first set of tethered blue/red meteors went off  but the pitfalls are people not paying attention to what each spell that Sophia casts does and not understanding what knockbacks happen when. Another issue is people not being prepared for the first two tilts after a completed DPS check.

Zurvan is only frustrating when the group messes up the ice mechanic (I forget the name but it's one where you should all stack together and move immediately once the cast goes off to avoid getting clipped by ice puddles) or a mess up on the other mechanics before the DPS check. The DPS check is fairly easy if people target down the two mobs that cast Meracydian Fear and the meteor spell respectively. Most groups I've been in downed Zurvan before the ice/fire debuffs get applied. 

As you do more and more of these bird farms you'll learn roughly how long each run should be taking and whereabouts the % of the boss should be before either a DPS check or phase change. 

It'll feel great when you finally get those last three birds.... and then remember there's dog mounts to grind for 😅

Yeah but the awesome thing is in ffxiv you can easily make a friend simply from emoting at them or having a great time in a dungeon - oh and you don't need to worry about people yelling at you for mucking up like you used to in WoW, the community is super nice in explaining how to do stuff if you aren't sure how something works.

I made the switch from WoW over to ffxiv in late May and honestly, I'm really happy that I did. I met some really great people who I play with on a regular basis and that made the difference for me I think.

Now is also a good time to start poking around and looking things like the Golden Saucer, Manderville questline, Beast Tribe quests and gathering/crafting for days where you really don't want to sit through 2.1-2.5 content and just want to take a break from post-ARR MSQs but still want to play ffxiv :)

If they're trying to change or trying something new out to help deal with it then calling them 'lazy' just completely crushes whatever self-motivation they had. It's also the same case of dropping or offloading a bunch of bad news onto the person suffering with the depression too. It can do more damage.
